title: Matrix
lead: Each judged product, placed within its type by its sales pace and its margin per unit.
noneJudged: No product can be judged yet in this period.

apart.title: Off the matrix
apart.lead: Too early to judge or nothing sold: these products are not placed.

past: This period is over: verdicts only read on a period that runs up to today.

lines.pace: Vertical line: pace limit {limit}, that is {percent}% of the average pace of {type} ({average}).
lines.unitMargin: Horizontal line: margin limit {limit} per unit, that is {percent}% of their average margin per unit ({average}).

how.lines: Each type has its own two lines, drawn from the average of its judged products. Right of the vertical line, the product sells well: its pace reaches {pace}% of the type's average pace. Above the horizontal line, it earns well: its margin per unit reaches {margin}% of the type's average margin per unit.
